guard/30071.htm.text: Captain Lucas: Welcome, young friend. Welcome to Dion! I am Lucas, the man responsible for the security of Dion. Is this your first time to Dion? I don't know what brought you here, but bear in mind that this is a quiet and law-abiding town. I don't tolerate anyone looking only to disturb the peace…

links.text: Look at the list of Kamaloka.
Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30071-01.htm.text: Captain Lucas: What brings you to me? A suspicious person, you say? Well, we see a very large number of suspicious-looking people here, so you need to be a little more specific.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30071-03.htm.text: Captain Lucas: No one saw him pass this way. Go look for up north.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30071-01.html.text: Captain Lucas: Maria's scroll... Ah yes, I have heard of its importance. We have looked everywhere and are still unable to find it. The thief must be very cunning. It is very unusual to have no clues in a whole month! Maybe we should consult a fortune-teller... Anyway, please tell Maria that I am t…

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30071-02.html.text: Captain Lucas: Please give my message to Maria . Be patient, I will catch the thief as soon as I can.
when: state STARTED; has items 2675,2689,2680,2683,2682,2684,2681; lacks items 2679

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30071-03.html.text: Captain Lucas: You saw the fortune-teller? Fortune-teller, astrologer, what's the difference? I was only kidding the other day when I suggested it. Who thought you would have taken me seriously? I guess I just ran out of ideas... What is that picture, anyway? Why are you holding such a thing? Ah! H…

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30071-05.html.text: Captain Lucas: If this mirror is correct, the person who stole the scroll will be among the Leto Lizardmen . We might find the scroll if we find them.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30071-06.html.text: Captain Lucas: We have recovered all the scrolls from the leto Lizardman! Thank God. Take them to Maria immediately.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30071-07.html.text: Captain Lucas: I'm afraid I didn't express my gratitude adequately before. Thanks to you we recovered the scrolls from the leto Lizardman. I am in your debt...

Q10277_MutatedKaneusDion/30071-01.htm.text: Captain Lucas: I heard tales of your recent activities. You have already acquired a reputation as an accomplished adventurer. Perhaps you have already heard about the Mutated Kaneus of Kamaloka . I have been asked to help investigate these strange creatures, but my duties unfortunately keep me far …

links.text: "What kind of help do you need?"

Q10277_MutatedKaneusDion/30071-00.html.text: Captain Lucas: Based on my observations, I don't think you are yet ready to handle the Kaneus. (Only characters level 28 and above are permitted to undertake this quest.)

Q10277_MutatedKaneusDion/30071-05.html.text: Captain Lucas: Ah! Are these the cellular tissues of Crimson Hatu and Seer Flouros ? From their pristine appearance, I can tell you were very careful. I couldn't have done better myself. Well done! Now take these samples to Magister Mirien at the Temple of Einhasad. He will be very pleased. If we c…

Q10277_MutatedKaneusDion/30071-04.html.text: Captain Lucas: The magisters become agitated if their research is delayed for any reason, so deliver the cellular tissue samples as quickly as possible. Those aren't people you want irritated with you, you know! Hurry to Kamaloka, and good hunting!

Q10277_MutatedKaneusDion/30071-06.html.text: Captain Lucas: Ah, it's you! Magister Mirien asked me to convey his gratitude to you. He said that the cellular tissues of the mutated Kaneus from the Kamaloka of Dion that you delivered to the were a great help. Well done!

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30071-02.htm.text: Captain Lucas: No, I haven't seen anyone matching that description here, nor has Guard Metty. If he fled northwest, perhaps he snuck out north through the alley? Why don't you go ask?

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30071-04.html.text: Captain Lucas: Do you mean this is the reflection of the thief? I can't help noticing that it looks exactly like a Leto Lizardman. He appears to be a perfect Warrior... I heard that the Leto Lizardmen have been seen in the southeastern part of Oren. If this fortune-teller's mirror is correct, we ha…

Q10277_MutatedKaneusDion/30071-02.htm.text: Captain Lucas: I heard from Magister Mirien in the Temple of Einhasad that the Sages of Magic, a group of magisters to which Magister Mirien belongs, are researching the Kaneus -- the monsters of the Kamaloka that recently came into existence; he has asked me for a favor. Kamaloka exists between th…

Q10277_MutatedKaneusDion/30071-03.html.text: Captain Lucas: Excellent! Visit either of the 2 Kamalokas we can enter from Dion, kill the Kaneus there and extract their cellular tissues.
